entities.summary: Markus Beyer was a German professional boxer who won the World Boxing Council super middleweight title three times. As an amateur, he represented Germany at the 1992 and 1996 Olympic Games in the light middleweight division. He also won a bronze medal at the 1995 World Amateur Boxing Championships and silver at the 1996 European Amateur Boxing Championships.
